translations.web: Then I saw all the labor and achievement that is the envy of a man’s neighbor. This also is vanity and a striving after wind.
translations.bsb: I saw that all labor and success spring from a man’s envy of his neighbor. This too is futile and a pursuit of the wind.
translations.kjv: Again, I considered all travail, and every right work, that for this a man is envied of his neighbour. This is also vanity and vexation of spirit.
translations.asv: Then I saw all labor and every skilful work, that for this a man is envied of his neighbor. This also is vanity and a striving after wind.
